name: imdb_selector_component_ablation_v1
purpose: Decompose the full IMDb routed-K selector into gradient-only, loss-only, and semantic-margin-only matched-K controls without modifying the frozen IMDb primary or matched-K evidence chain.

chronology.official_results_observed_before_design: The IMDb primary and matched-K official results had already been observed; this ablation is post-hoc and cannot be described as prospective, predeclared, or confirmatory.
chronology.relationship_to_original_analysis: The original IMDb primary D-C gate and the matched-K secondary Holm family are unchanged. These records may only diagnose which score component carries ranking signal in the already observed IMDb matched-K result.
chronology.relationship_to_ag_news: AG News secondary execution is independent and still running; this IMDb selector ablation must not be mixed with AG as confirmation evidence.

selection_contract.gradient_only_k: Compute the original router's target-row anchor-gradient cosine and select the best 64 examples per claimed IMDb label by P(-anchor_cosine), with deterministic hash tie breaking.
selection_contract.loss_only_k: Compute the original router's target-row local training loss and select the best 64 examples per claimed IMDb label by P(loss), with deterministic hash tie breaking.
selection_contract.margin_only_k: Compute the target-row canonical semantic margin and select the best 64 examples per claimed IMDb label by P(semantic_margin), with deterministic hash tie breaking.

official_evaluation.execution_rule: Run and retain the complete 10-by-3 matrix; never add seeds, drop arms, or alter tests based on outcomes.

analysis.reference_records: Existing severe_routed_k records from imdb_matched_control_addendum_v1 remain the full-router reference and must continue to verify under their original verifier.

secondary_holm_family.test: two-sided paired Student t-test over ten common seeds
two-sided paired Student t-test over ten common seeds
two-sided paired Student t-test over ten common seeds

analysis.multiplicity: Holm adjustment over exactly the three post-hoc secondary p-values at familywise alpha 0.05
analysis.confidence_intervals: Unadjusted two-sided 95% Student-t intervals over paired seed differences, labelled post-hoc secondary
prohibited: Do not describe this study as prospective, predeclared, confirmatory, or independent.
Do not alter the original IMDb primary gate or matched-K secondary family.
Do not claim deployable superiority unless separately validated.

evidence_boundaries: This ablation was designed after the IMDb official primary and matched-K results were observed.
All records reuse the official IMDb test and are post-hoc secondary diagnostics.
All arms share the severe mixture, K=128, 64-per-claimed-label quotas, optimizer settings, anchors, models, and server training budget.
The known task interface excludes off-task rows before component selection; clean versus conflict identity is not used.
The audit can diagnose score-component sensitivity within this setting but cannot confirm the TREC-derived direction, change the IMDb primary gate, or establish a general selector.
